inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject or downgrade the edge if AI-memory demand or pricing weakens materially, Samsung loses sustained customer qualification, non-AI weakness offsets memory gains, or incremental capital fails to earn adequate returns.
inputs.proposed_mechanism: AI training and inference infrastructure can transmit into Samsung preferred-share economics through qualified HBM, server DRAM and enterprise SSD demand, pricing, utilization, margins and cash generation.

objective: Review whether Samsung Electronics preferred GDR has a material causal relationship to AI compute, networking and hyperscaler monetization through HBM and server-memory demand; accept or reject the edge.
